checks.result: The card pool is the 18 data cards at 75/22/3% for 100/1000 crystal; pet/artifact pools are disabled and never appear; the Store page shows those rates/prices from the same data.
A pull debits crystal, adds the cards and moves pity in one receipt; with 99 crystal the state is unchanged (INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES).
The same server seed reproduces identical cards and pity; duplicates are distinct instances that feed card dust (20/40/80) for the existing card upgrade path, and locked cards refuse salvage.
A worst-case sequence gives silver at pull 10 and 20, gold at 30, then the counters reset; counters live in the save and pass validateAccount (reload). Live: 1 card pull through the real API/DB.

limitations: There is no separate pull-history screen; the persisted pity counters and receipts are the history. Rates are baselines for TASK-041.
